name: reading-note-reviewer
description: A calm reading-note reviewer packaged as a web app and Android app.

scripts.android:build:system: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run prepare:android && cap add android
scripts.cap:copy: npm run prepare:android && cap copy android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:android && cap sync android
scripts.verify:webapp: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && mvn test
